description: Narrow grant for the in-page login detector (v0.18.26): account, tabbed, and split-pane webviews may invoke ONLY the six password-prompt commands, which offer to save a submitted login and fill a saved one. Remote pages get these because the detector runs in the page itself; each command is label-derived, domain-locked in Rust, and confirm/fill need a recent trusted gesture, so a page script cannot exfiltrate or overwrite a vault entry on its own.
